Help Privacy policy Sample images

Read a QR code by right-clicking its image

Right-click an image on a web page and choose “Read QR codes in this image” to view or copy the result, or open a web link yourself. You can also click the extension icon to choose, drop, or paste an image. The menu label may vary by extension version and Chrome display language.

Try the right-click scanner on a sample image

Scanning happens on your device

No account or camera is needed. There is no decoding server, advertising, or analytics. Images and results are not sent to the developer. The extension requests the original from its website only when you choose “Read original.”

No QR code found?

Try a clearer image that shows the whole code, or crop closely around the code. If the website blocks access or requires you to sign in, try “Read original,” or save the image or take a screenshot and import it. The extension accepts images Chrome can open, including PNG, JPG, and WebP, up to 20 MB.

How to clear data

Choose “Clear” at the top right to remove the current image and results. Under “Privacy and help,” you can clear all temporary images, revoke website access, or read the privacy policy. The extension does not keep a scan history, open links automatically, connect to Wi-Fi, or import contacts.

Contact support

devsaddle@gmail.com

When reporting a problem, include your Chrome version, the steps you took, and any error message. Please do not send passwords, payment codes, or other private QR codes.
